characters.description: East Asian detective in a soaked charcoal trench coat, silver-rimmed glasses beaded with rain, sharp tired eyes, short dark hair
Courier in an iridescent plum vinyl jacket, bob-cut dark hair with subtle cyan streak, metallic briefcase cuffed to left wrist

assets.prompt: Cinematic character reference board, three-view turnaround (front, three-quarter, profile) on neutral slate backdrop: 31-year-old East Asian male detective in a soaked charcoal trench coat, silver-rimmed glasses, short dark hair, realistic film grain, 35mm lens, high detail.

Cinematic character reference board, three-view turnaround (front, three-quarter, profile) on neutral slate backdrop: 27-year-old female courier in an iridescent plum vinyl jacket, dark bob hair with subtle cyan streak, metallic briefcase on wrist, realistic neo-noir cinematography.

Wide establishing concept frame of a rain-slick cyberpunk back-alley noodle stall at midnight, steam rising from stainless counter, warm amber lantern glow clashing with cyan neon signage reflected in wet asphalt puddles, empty street, photorealistic anamorphic 35mm.

shots.camera: Low-angle medium-wide tracking shot, 35mm anamorphic, slow push-in through rain
shots.action: CHR_REN steps out of neon-lit mist under the noodle stall awning, shaking rain from his charcoal trench coat as reflections shimmer on wet asphalt.

shots.camera: Tight over-shoulder medium close-up, shallow depth of field
shots.action: CHR_REN adjusts his rain-beaded glasses and looks toward the alley entrance as distant footsteps splash.

shots.camera: Reverse medium shot, subtle handheld breathe, amber-cyan cross lighting
shots.action: CHR_VERA emerges from the neon alley shadow, lifting her cuffed wrist slightly to reveal the metallic briefcase under her plum jacket.

shots.camera: Two-shot profile across the steaming noodle counter, slow dolly right
shots.action: CHR_VERA sets the metallic briefcase firmly onto the wet steel counter between them; steam curls upward across both faces.
